summary: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, computer security expert, strong advocate for privacy and anonymity, interest in Tor and VPN technologies, expertise in compartmentalization and digital security practices, critical of government surveillance, engaged in discussions about drug policy and harm reduction, frequent contributor to online privacy and security forums, interest in cryptocurrencies, particularly Bitcoin, and their use for anonymous transactions, strong belief in the importance of pseudonymity online, critical of pharmaceutical industry practices, and supportive of open-source software.
